title: Partner Sales Executive - Construction, Utilities, Retail, Logistics
description:
Mendix accelerates digital transformation by bridging the gap between business and IT. As the creator of the leading Agentic Low-Code platform and part of Siemens, we combine the entrepreneurial spirit of a fast-growing software company with the global strength and stability of one of the world's leading technology organizations.
Are you a commercially driven sales professional who loves creating opportunities, winning new business, and building strategic partnerships with our Focus Partners?
As a Partner Sales Executive, you will develop new business within a dedicated territory in Belux, covering Construction, Utilities, Retail, Logistics. Working closely with Mendix's strategic Focus Partners, you'll build pipeline, win new customers, and help organizations accelerate their digital transformation with our Agentic Low-Code platform.
You will have a dedicated territory, giving you the ownership and autonomy to develop creative sales initiatives and build lasting relationships with both partners and customers. At Mendix, your ideas matter, initiative is encouraged, and success is celebrated.

In the role of Partner Sales Executive you'll:: - Develop new business opportunities within your dedicated territory - Construction, Utilities, Retail, Logistics. - Build trusted relationships and joint business plans with Mendix's strategic Focus Partners. - Identify, qualify, and close high-value sales opportunities together with partners. - Build executive relationships within target accounts and guide complex enterprise sales cycles. - Launch joint sales and marketing initiatives that generate measurable pipeline. - Lead commercial negotiations and successfully close new business. - Collaborate with Partner Management, Solution Architects, and Marketing to maximize partner engagement and accelerate new business.
What you'll achieve in your first year:: - Build a healthy pipeline within your dedicated territory. - Win new logo customers together with our Focus Partners. - Execute successful partner campaigns that generate qualified opportunities. - Consistently achieve your commercial targets, supported by a realistic ramp-up period. - Become a trusted commercial advisor for both customers and partners.
You're the innovator we need if you have:: - 3+ years of successful software sales experience with a proven track record of exceeding targets. - Experience managing complex B2B or enterprise sales opportunities within Construction, Utilities, Retail or Logistics. - An entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and accountability. - Creativity, perseverance, and a genuine "can-do" attitude. - A coachable mindset and a willingness to continuously learn and improve. - A strong closing mentality and the drive to win. - Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Dutch and English. - Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM platform. - A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. A background in software delivery or digital transformation is a plus.
Why join Mendix?: - Experience the entrepreneurial culture of Mendix, backed by the strength and stability of Siemens. - Own your dedicated territory and make a visible commercial impact. - Work alongside a select group of strategic Focus Partners to shape digital transformation in Belux . - Enjoy the freedom to build your own business, develop creative go-to-market initiatives, and grow your career. - Join a collaborative, high-performing sales team that values initiative, creativity, a …[truncated]

scoring.why: Partner-led new-logo hunting in a dedicated BeLux territory (incl. retail, logistics), asking 3+ yrs software sales with Dutch/English: close to your HPE hunting and partner co-sell, with Siemens-group stability.
scoring.risk: Wants software (not services/infra) sales track record in construction/utilities verticals; posted July 2026, so the requisition may be far along.

title: Key Accountmanager
description:
Over deze job
 Axians Audiovisual, een onderneming van VINCI Energies, is gespecialiseerd in audiovisuele technieken voor tertiaire gebouwen, van ontwerp tot uitvoering . We zijn actief in diverse segmenten, zoals scholen, publieke gebouwen enz.
 Ben jij een relatiebouwer met een passie voor technologie? Help organisaties de werkplek van de toekomst te realiseren, bouw strategische partnerships uit binnen de BENELUX en geniet van een gevarieerde functie met gemiddeld twee internationale verplaatsingen per maand, al dan niet met overnachting.
 Als Senior Key Accountmanager sta je in voor:
- Sterke en duurzame relaties uit te bouwen met klanten en strategische partners binnen de audiovisuele markt
- Nieuwe commerciële opportuniteiten te detecteren, prospecten te overtuigen en deze uit te bouwen tot succesvolle langetermijnsamenwerkingen
- Klanten te adviseren en te inspireren met innovatieve audiovisuele oplossingen die perfect aansluiten bij hun uitdagingen en ambities
- Nauw samen te werken met onze technische experts, projectmanagers, … om projecten succesvol van concept tot oplevering te realiseren
- Marktontwikkelingen, technologische innovaties en klantbehoeften continu op te volgen en deze te vertalen naar nieuwe businesskansen
 Actief bijdragen aan de groei en positionering van Axians Audiovisual door duurzame relaties te onderhouden en kwaliteit in elke samenwerking te waarborgen.
 Profiel:
- Idealiter ben je in het bezit van een Bachelor diploma of gelijkwaardig door ervaring
- Je kan ervaring voorleggen als Accountmanager binnen een technische omgeving -en nog mooier meegenomen als dit een audiovisuele setting was (minimale van ervaring 5 jaar)
- Door de internationale context kan je u vlot uitdrukken in het Nederlands, Engels -en Frans
- Lastenboeken kunnen interpreteren of een uitgesproken interesse om dit aan te leren is een must 
 Wat mag je verwachten?
- Een competitief loon, afgestemd op jouw ervaring
- Bedrijfswagen, laad/tankkaart -en carwashkaart
- Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering
- Maaltijdcheques
- CAO 90 bonus als extra waardering (mits het behalen van bedrijfsdoelstellingen)
- Eindejaarspremie
- Arbeidsduurvermindering: 6 extra verlofdagen per jaar
- Sectorpremie via PC 200
- Opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden – horizontaal of verticaal
- Aandelen aankopen? Dat kan bij ons!
- Een collegiale sfeer met ruimte voor plezier: teambuildings, BBQ’s, familiedagen en personeelsfeesten
 Klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging met een vleugje rock & roll? 
 Solliciteer via de knop ‘Ik ben geïnteresseerd’.
 #PoweredByYourEnergy #BuiltOnSkill #PoweredByAudiovisuals 
 Wij hechten veel belang aan gelijke kansen en diversiteit. Kandidaten worden geselecteerd op basis van hun kwaliteiten en vaardigheden. Discriminatie op basis van leeftijd, geslacht, genderidentiteit, afkomst, nationaliteit, religie, handicap, oriëntatie of andere beschermde kenmerken wordt niet getolereerd.

scoring.why: Senior KAM for BENELUX workplace/AV projects at Axians (VINCI Energies, Global 500), strategic partnerships with regular international travel.
scoring.risk: Audiovisual integration is adjacent to, not on, your IT-infra path; Roeselare is ~1h30 from Antwerp and 85K OTE is uncertain.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager (Mid-Market) Belgium
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.
 Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn and  Instagram .

Ultimately, the AE is accountable for exceeding monthly/quarterly quota, proactive deal management, forecast accuracy, and driving adoption/usage with customers and prospects in collaboration with internal teams and the broader Netskope partner ecosystem. - 4+ years of direct sales experience in a quota-carrying role 
- 1+ years selling cybersecurity software and/or SaaS solutions preferred 
- Verifiable track record of exceeding quotas year after year
- Understanding of enterprise web technologies and SaaS experience a must
- Success working with channel partners
- Ability to present and sell by phone / web-demo. 
- Highly motivated self-starters, eager to learn, determined to adapt quickly, and comfortable with some ambiguity

 The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, and market conditions.
 For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the On Target Earnings (OTE) range for the role, which is the sum of  …[truncated]

scoring.why: Belgium territory AE at a public cloud-security vendor, hunting plus expansion through channel partners; stated EU pay-transparency OTE 165-198K, technical depth in SASE/zero trust.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise (Hunter) - Belgium
description:

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Benelux Enterprise team is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. As trusted business partners, we work with the most ambitious market leaders and high-growth innovators, helping them build the financial infrastructure that powers their next stage of growth. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem-solving.

 Who you are 
 You are an adept salesperson, capable of selling value into prospective customers, engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer  …[truncated]

title: Account Executive Public Sector
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What Is The Role 
 Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic Public Sector Account Executive. To excel as an Account Executive at Elastic , you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.
 As a Public Sector Enterprise Account Executive, you will be an integral part of our growth strategy. You will drive net-new revenue and expansion within Public Sector Accounts in Belgium. This is an opportunity for those passionate about empowering companies through cutting-edge search technology and analytics, enabling them to unlock the full potential of their data.
 What You Will Be Doing 
- Drive Adoption: Fuel the adoption of Elastic’s AI-powered search solutions, Observability and Security solutions within (new) Public Sector accounts while deepening engagement with existing ones.
- Be a Trusted Advisor: Assist users and customers in harnessing the full power of search analytics to transform data into actionable insights.

- Champion Open Source: Articulate the value of our advanced commercial features while advocating for our Open-Source offerings.
- Identify New Use Cases: Showcase how Elastic’s solutions enable users to work more efficiently and intelligently.

- Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

- Value Storytelling: The ability to craft tailored narratives that link Elastic’s technical capabilities (Search, Observability, Security) to measurable business outcomes like revenue gain or risk mitigation is critical
- Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing di …[truncated]

title: Microsoft Alliance Manager
location: Chicago, United States / Ghent, Belgium / London, United Kingdom
description:
🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers. 
 Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. Aikido builds developer-first security products that reduce real risk without getting in the way of shipping software. We focus on what actually matters and automate the rest.
 We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place.
 Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. Build things that matter.
 As our Microsoft Alliance Manager, you will turn Aikido’s fit with the Microsoft stack, spanning code, cloud and workforce security, into more demand, pipeline and commercial growth. You’ll create the motion yourself by building demand, enabling the field, activating partners, running co-sell, operating Marketplace and turning activity into qualified opportunities. 
- Own Aikido’s Better Together with Microsoft story, working with Product to strengthen the fit and Marketing to bring it to market
- Execute targeted campaigns, customer stories, and ecosystem/industry events
- Run the operating cadence: target accounts and mapping, opportunity registration, pipeline reviews, follow-up and business reviews
- Enable Microsoft field teams to position  and bring us into relevant customer conversations
- Develop sell-with motions with Microsoft-focused resellers or SI partners
- Grow and operate Azure Marketplace across self-service, private offers and MACC-backed enterprise transactions, including conversion, renewals and reporting
- Manage Aikido’s participation in Marketplace, IP Co-Sell, ISV Success and Security programs, and use relevant Microsoft funding and incentives
- 5+ years of experience in cloud alliances, partnerships or partner GTM
- Proven experience working closely with Microsoft as an ISV with a strong understanding of how Microsoft works with ISV’s
- Proven track record of growing pipeline through demand generation, hyperscaler field engagement and partner-led motions
- Good knowledge of Microsoft’s security, software development and workforce protection ecosystem
- Strong knowledge of Marketplace Ops including private offers, MACC, using tools such as HubSpot, Suger/Fours/Tackle and Crossbeam
- Commercial and hands-on, with the focus to navigate a complex organization and deliver outcomes
- Microsoft’s Europe North partner team in EMEA runs our partnership, so you need daily overlap with their CET working day.
 What you can expect 
- Short decision lines. Big ownership. Shape the projects that matter and ship fast.
- Grow as fast as we do. Take on more, own more, and carve out your own path.
- Top-tier tech pay and equity.
- High trust, strong values, zero corporate BS.
- Flexibility in working hours.
- A company that sticks to its values in an open and informal atmosphere.
 We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

scoring.why: Own Aikido's Microsoft co-sell, Marketplace and partner motion from Ghent at an $85M-funded security scale-up: a direct route into hyperscaler alliance work.
scoring.risk: Expects proven ISV-Microsoft alliance and Marketplace ops experience you don't have yet; pay not published.
